Calculate relative importance using maximum utility contribution.

maximum_utility_contribution.Rd

Maximum Utility Contribution is calculated by multiplying the criteria level range (difference between the highest and lowest level) with the absolute value of the criterion weight. To calculate a percentage, the maximum utility contributions are summed.

Usage

maximum_utility_contribution()

Examples

maximum_utility_contribution()
